payload.answer: Approximately 8.30% (1250 gap characters out of 15059 total alignment positions across the 10 per-file alignments). NOTE: MAFFT was not available in this environment and could not be installed (no network); the value was computed with a clearly-labeled pure-Python progressive fallback aligner (UPGMA guide tree, BLOSUM62, affine gaps open=10/extend=0.5), not with MAFFT --auto, so it is an approximation of the MAFFT-auto result.
